result.note: Tests the vessel type of INS Nipun, an indigenous Navy commissioning with a regional-strategy angle.

questions.prompt: In September 2026, the Indian Navy commissioned INS Nipun. Which of the following best describes this vessel?
questions.explain: INS Nipun is an indigenous submarine rescue vessel, commissioned on 2 September 2026. The Navy is using it to position India as the Indian Ocean's "Preferred Submarine Rescue Partner" as it competes with China for regional influence.
questions.source: The Navy commissioned INS Nipun, an indigenous submarine rescue vessel
